import html # Template for the user profile; placeholders are marked with {name}, {bio} and {status} PROFILE_FORMAT = """

{name}

{bio}

{status}
""" def generate_user_profile(username: str, biography: str, status: str) -> str: """ Render a sanitized user profile for web display. Parameters ---------- username : str The user's name as entered. biography : str A user‑written biography that may span multiple sentences. status : str The user's current status message. Returns ------- str A formatted string containing the sanitized user profile ready for rendering in HTML. Raises ------ ValueError If any of the arguments are not strings. """ if not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in (username, biography, status)): raise ValueError("All arguments must be strings") # Escape any special HTML characters to prevent injection attacks safe_name = html.escape(username.strip()) safe_bio = html.escape(biography.strip()) safe_status = html.escape(status.strip()) # Render the template with sanitized values rendered_profile = PROFILE_FORMAT.format( name=safe_name, bio=safe_bio, status=safe_status ) return rendered_profile.strip()
